```lean
theorem lg_target {α β : Type*} (f : α → β) (g : β → α) (h : ∀ x, g (f x) = x) : Function.Injective f := by
  intro x₁ x₂
  obtain h1 := h x₁
  obtain h2 := h x₂
  assume H : f x₁ = f x₂
  have eq : g (f x₁) = g (f x₂) := by rw [H]
  have eq' : x₁ = x₂ := by rw [eq, h1, h2]
  exact eq'
```
